ITA-5.76.20 bṛṃhaṇa-atiyogaḥ बृंहण-अतियोगः
Condition of excessive nourishing therapy

ITA-5.76.19 bṛṃhaṇa-apacāraḥ बृंहण-अपचारः
Condition due to improper nourishing therapy

ITA-9.1.43 bṛṁhaṇam/ bṛṁhaṇacikitsā बृंहणम्/बृंहणचिकित्सा
Bulk-enhancing
One of the six types of treatment modalities: a procedure which is nutritive, nourishing, increases body weight, promotes growth or enhances bulk.

ITA-9.5.72 bṛṃhaṇadhūmapānam बृंहणधूमपानम्
Nourishing medicated smoking
The procedure of medicated smoking with nourishing effect.

ITA-9.2.95 bṛmhaṇanasyam बृंहणनस्यम्
Nourishing intranasal therapy
A type of nasya therapy with the primary aim of nourishment.
